content: {"episode_id": "ep-05173", "cpt": "93229", "denial_carc": "CO-197", "necessity_paragraph": "The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation as the underlying etiology.
